SELECT a.assigned_to_company_id AS groupId, COALESCE(c.name, '未知机构') AS groupName, COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(DISTINCT a.template_id) AS templates, SUM(a.status IN ('pending', 'filling')) AS filling, SUM(a.status = 'submitted') AS reviewing, SUM(a.status IN ('pending_receipt', 'approved')) AS pendingReceipt, SUM(a.status IN ('received', 'aggregated')) AS received, SUM(a.status IN ('rejected', 'returned')) AS rejected FROM report_assignments a LEFT JOIN companies c ON c.id = a.assigned_to_company_id
WHERE a.status != 'recalled'
WHERE a.issuer_department_id = #{companyId} AND a.status != 'recalled'
WHERE a.assigned_to_company_id = #{companyId} AND a.status != 'recalled'
GROUP BY a.assigned_to_company_id, c.name ORDER BY total DESC
